verification_status.verification_notes: The lead was the Aston 'Global Ambassador Scholarship'; the old URL now redirects to Aston's general international scholarships page, which no longer lists it (only a testimonial mentions it). This record covers the Sir Adrian Cadbury Chancellor's Scholarship on that page instead. Deadlines differ by intake: January 2027 closes 1 Nov 2026 (decision 6 Nov); April and September 2027 deadlines TBC. The page also lists an automatic International Community Scholarship (GBP 4,000 to 5,500 off fees for postgraduates). Exact list of excluded courses not fully read.
